differences.title: 1. REACTIVITY MODEL
differences.leftDesc: Updates only what changed, no VDOM diffing.
differences.rightDesc: Vue's robust system tracks dependencies for updates.

differences.title: 2. PERFORMANCE
differences.rightDesc: Efficient VDOM and reactivity for good performance.

differences.title: 3. COMPILATION
differences.leftDesc: Compiles directly to efficient DOM operations.
differences.rightDesc: Uses VDOM for efficient diffing and updates.

differences.title: 4. LEARNING CURVE
differences.leftDesc: Unique reactivity concept requires new thinking.
differences.rightDesc: Familiar patterns, easy to pick up.

differences.title: 5. ECOSYSTEM
differences.rightDesc: Vast libraries, established tools, strong community.

differences.title: 6. STATE MANAGEMENT
differences.leftDesc: Native fine-grained state management via signals.
differences.rightDesc: External libraries for centralized state management.

differences.title: 7. SYNTAX
differences.leftDesc: Closer to JavaScript, uses JSX-like syntax.
differences.rightDesc: Offers HTML-like templates and TSX support.
